title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Luke 17: forgiving a brother, faith like a mustard seed, the ten lepers and the day of the Son of Man.

questions.text: What does he say it would be better to have hung around the neck of the one who makes a little one stumble?
questions.explanation: He says it would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck and he were thrown into the sea.

answers.text: A yoke of oxen
A millstone
A chain and fetters
A bag of stones

questions.text: How often does he say to forgive a brother who sins against you and repents in one day?
questions.explanation: He says that if your brother sins against you seven times in the day and seven times returns saying, "I repent," you shall forgive him.

answers.text: Three times
Ten times
Seventy times
Seven times

questions.text: What does he say faith like a grain of mustard seed could do?
questions.explanation: He says that with such faith you could tell this sycamore tree to be uprooted and planted in the sea, and it would obey you.

answers.text: Uproot a sycamore tree and plant it in the sea
Move a mountain from its place into the sea
Make a barren fig tree bear fruit at once
Calm a wind storm on the lake

questions.text: What are the servants told to say when they have done all they were commanded?
questions.explanation: They are to say, "We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty."

answers.text: "Our lord owes us thanks for our work."
"We have done more than was commanded us."
"We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty."
"Prepare our supper, for we have served."

questions.text: How many lepers met him as he entered a certain village, and where did they stand?
questions.explanation: Ten men who were lepers met him, and they stood at a distance.

answers.text: Ten, kneeling at his feet
Ten, standing at a distance
Seven, standing in the road
One, standing at the gate

questions.text: What did he tell the lepers to do?
questions.explanation: He told them to go and show themselves to the priests, and as they went they were cleansed.

answers.text: Wash in the river
Tell no one what had happened
Go and show themselves to the priests
Return to their own houses

questions.text: What does the text say about the one who turned back to give thanks?
questions.explanation: The one who turned back fell on his face at Jesus' feet to thank him, and he was a Samaritan.

answers.text: He was a priest
He was a ruler of the synagogue
He was one of the apostles
He was a Samaritan

questions.text: What did he answer the Pharisees who asked when God's Kingdom would come?
questions.explanation: He answered that God's Kingdom does not come with observation, and that God's Kingdom is within you.

answers.text: That it does not come with observation, but is within you
That it would come in that same hour and place
That it would come with signs in the sky
That no one may know the day it comes

questions.text: What rained from the sky on the day that Lot went out from Sodom?
questions.explanation: On the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

answers.text: A flood of water
Hail and stones
Fire and sulfur
Darkness and ashes

questions.text: What did he answer when they asked him, "Where, Lord?"
questions.explanation: He said to them, "Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together."

answers.text: In the days of Noah and of Lot
Where the body is, there the vultures will be gathered
On the housetops of Jerusalem at night
Where two are grinding grain together
